name: problem_031_flux_timestep_guidance_projection_embedding_cuda_cpp
author: sol-baselines-codegen
description: fp32 FLUX timestep + guidance projection embedding (generates the temb conditioning signal). Six-launch chain in CUDA C++: 2 custom CUDA kernels (fused sin/cos/cat for timestep_embed[B, 768]; in-place SiLU over [B, 3072]) around 3 cuBLAS at::linear calls (timestep_linear1, timestep_linear2, text_embedder) plus 1 add_. Workloads have small batch_size (1..59), so the win comes from collapsing the reference's elementwise chain rather than out-running cuBLAS at the matmuls. inner_dim=3072, pooled_projection_dim=768, time_embed_dim=768, half_time_embed_dim=384 pinned. Destination-passing style.
